thread:
eli: okay serious poll — who else heard the Office Snickerdoodle at ~3pm? :cookie: i heard a tiny bell by the snack cabinet and now i am convinced we have a guardian pastry
maya: 100% heard it. i was alone in the kitchen at 3:02, cookies arranged in a suspicious spiral :thinking_face: could be wind tho
sanju: it’s definitely #snickerdoodle. left an offering (one bourbon biscuit) and it vanished. ghost confirmed :ghost:
ruth: @eli stop feeding the legend with your dramatic whistling. also who named it Snickerdoodle?
eli: credit to harper — the christening happened after the great sugar heist of 2023. harper, confess.
harper: guilty. i named it after finding crumbs in an S shape. took an oath and a bow :shushing_face:
ops-bot: Kitchen inventory updated: cookies -8. If you bring snacks, please log them in #kitchen-log.
maya: proposal: plaque on the snack cabinet. text: "In honor of the Snickerdoodle" :laughing:
sanju: poll time — react to vote: :thumbsup: plaque, :pray: tiny shrine, :money_with_wings: snacks fund
eli: :thumbsup:
maya: :pray:
harper: :money_with_wings:
ruth: :money_with_wings:
sanju: snacks fund wins by dramatic hand-raising. i’ll drop off a tin tomorrow at 2:55pm. will the legend accept a tin offering?
eli: leave it on top of the microwave, ring the bell at 3, step back slowly. ceremonial protocol established.
maya: mandatory CCTV for folklore documentation? `cctv_3pm.mov` — kidding. unless people are into blurry artifacts.
harper: true folklore requires at least one blurry photo. i’ll bring a disposable camera for authenticity.
ruth: also quick shoutout to whoever fixed the fridge temp this week. tiny wins. :tada:
eli: agreed. Snickerdoodle lore lives on. new nickname for the kitchen: "The Shrine of Snacks"
ops-bot: Reminder: please label personal snacks. Unattended food may be adopted by The Snickerdoodle.
maya: next week's thread idea: Snickerdoodle's pen heists. :eyes:
sanju: all in favor of a laminated sticker for the kitchen door? :raising_hand:
eli: ongoing saga concluded: snacks fund + shrine rituals + ceremonial bell. long live the Snickerdoodle.
